experiment: non-destructive mutual-best learned residual union over bilateral buddies96
hypothesis: A sparse set of high-confidence k16 learned mutual-best edges can add true local adjacency while preserving every bilateral mutual-best edge and avoiding the SSIM regression of full learned-score replacement.

historical_exposure.reason: outputs/legacy-upgrade/calibration700-champion/report.json historically enumerated the complete calibration roster
historical_exposure.claim: The primary and confirmation panels are disjoint from each other, and this experiment freezes and commits all current-run predictions before reading either panel's targets. It does not claim untouched or globally fresh calibration.

train_only_arm_selection.selection_rule: Retain the five arms with the strongest combination of mean final-SSIM gain, positive adjacency gain, and conservative edge count on the fixed train-only diagnostic.

confirmation.authorised_only_if: At least one primary arm passes every frozen promotion gate; evaluate exactly the preregistered winning arm without retuning.

fusion_policy.proposal: learned mutual row/column top-one edge with positive residual
fusion_policy.non_destructive_guard: source and target must both be unused by every bilateral mutual-best edge in that direction
fusion_policy.analytic_guard: minimum count of frozen raw/tile_z/bilateral/gray views ranking the pair in top four
fusion_policy.confidence: minimum of learned row-margin/robust-row-scale and column-margin/robust-column-scale
fusion_policy.promotion: smallest float32 score strictly above current row and column maxima
fusion_policy.strict_geometry: all 576 original upright 20x20 dirty tiles exactly once
fusion_policy.tail: RGB seam offsets -> bounded luminance gains -> exactly one coloured NLM pass h20

artifacts: baseline and every evaluated arm right/down score matrices
freeze_before_target_access.commitment: Write content-addressed JSON, read it back, and verify its self-hash before reading any current panel target bytes.

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap of board-level mean differences

winner_rule: Among arms passing every gate, choose largest mean final SSIM, then largest mean adjacency, then preregistered priority order.
manual_review: Always render dirty/target/baseline/five-arm raw/final primary sheet. Numerical passage does not by itself prove manual-review quality.
failure_policy: If no primary arm passes every condition, confirmation, holdout, test, and production integration are forbidden. No thresholds or arms may be retuned on primary targets.
success_policy: If a primary arm passes, run only that frozen arm on confirmation 444:468. Require the identical gate again before recommending integration; do not access holdout or test in this experiment.
